task.title: Theme the site, the panel and PDFs
task.shortdesc: One stylesheet, named theme in opend.config.yaml, styles the docs site, the help panel and every PDF.

step.cmd: Override the --opend-* variables in your theme.
Optional: add print rules for PDFs.

info.p: The print document's body has the class publication. Useful hooks are .pub-cover, .pub-toc, .pub-chapter and .pub-part. PDFs always print in the light scheme.

step.cmd: Check the result on a page, in the help lab's panel and in the print HTML.

result.p: The theme loads after the built-in styles, and in PDFs after the print styles, so its rules win. This site's theme is site/theme/site.css.
result.note: In PDFs the theme is inlined into a document without a base URL, so url() references to fonts or images in it are not loaded. Use fonts installed on the server, or the system font stack.
